newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF received nine bln yen from private sector--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: MOF received nine bln yen from private sector--BOJ.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) received nine billion yen from the private sector in June, Bank of Japan (BOJ) data showed on Tuesday.
The ministry manages Japan's external reserves, which stood at $221.761 billion at the end of May.
Analysts said part of the money might have come from private-sector purchases of financing bills (FBs), which amounted to a net 46 billion yen in June.
Any other money, in yen, received by the ministry in the month could have included payments made for dollar-selling intervention to support the yen, but bankers doubted such a possibility.
The MOF does not comment on details of such payments.
The private sector institutions include commercial banks, foreign central banks, municipal governments, public funds and quasi-governmental organisations.
